component.name: Startup Manager
component.summary: Choose which apps and commands run when you log in

description.p: Startup Manager shows everything that starts when you log in and lets you change it with a switch. It can also run your own bash commands at login.

ul.li: Add installed apps (APT, Snap, Flatpak) or any program to your startup list
Pause, edit, delay or remove startup entries, with undo
Turn off entries that installed software added for everyone, for your account only, and restore them later
Run your own bash commands at login, with a syntax check, an optional delay, waiting for the network, Run Now for testing and saved output

screenshot.caption: Apps that start when you log in, each with an on/off switch
